name: mark-scrub
title: Mark scrub
description: A recognised number, duration, time of day, day, state or colour you change in place: drag up or down on the words in detents (Shift large, Alt small), or focus it and press the arrows; a held press or Enter asks the host for its picker (onPick: the host opens its Calendar in a Popover anchored to the words), and a duration says itself in its other unit on U or a sideways drag. The words are the value and are rewritten in place, one commit per gesture; the digits turn on the drum, the words hold their width while you drag, and an engraved scale stands beside them only while you drag. A spinbutton with a name; a push past a limit shakes the words.
